about: Real phone takes recorded with the Mic check screen (#/mic) and downloaded as WAV. Kept at the phone's own sample rate, unprocessed. Practice takes by a person, not wild-turkey references; test-only, not shipped in the app.

clips.notes: 5 s take on an Android phone in Chrome, 2026-11-12. Phone honoured echo cancellation, noise suppression and auto gain off; 1 channel; 48 kHz. Peak -10.6 dBFS (74% of full scale), noise floor -39.4 dBFS, 12 notes over 3.51 s. Unedited download from the Mic check screen.
clips.author: CameCallHero project owner
